episode_row: 02:00 reconcile reset the streak to 0 (walk broke on today's preview)

commits.subject: fix(picks): reconcile streak walk skips preview/future/shadow pick files
commits.body:
The 2am reconcile_results() was resetting streak to 0 every night because
its backward walk hit today's pre-generated preview pick (from `bts preview`)
and broke on the result=None sentinel. The preview file has no game result
yet — that's "not played", not "miss".

Symptom observed 2026-04-15: yesterday's Hoerner + Díaz double-down both hit
(streak should be 2), but streak.json was rewritten to 0 at 02:00 ET when
the reconcile cron ran.

Fix: filter the backward walk to only strict YYYY-MM-DD pick files AND skip
any file dated today or later. Strict date filter also incidentally fixes a
latent bug where *.shadow.json files (separate eval track) were being walked
— they always have result=None so they'd break the loop too.

Adds two regression tests:
- test_preview_pick_for_tomorrow_does_not_break_streak_walk
- test_shadow_pick_files_are_ignored_in_streak_walk

499 tests passing.
